caption: Culling removes whole objects (10,000 → 3,000 → 1,500) while LOD removes triangles inside each surviving object (1,500,000 → 600,000 per eye). At 90 frames a second that is 54 million triangles every second.

spec.title: Worked example: 10,000 objects, 1,000 triangles each
spec.aria: Flow of the worked example: 10,000 objects of 1,000 triangles each, frustum culling keeping 30 percent to leave 3,000 objects, occlusion culling keeping 50 percent to leave 1,500 drawn objects, 1,500,000 triangles before LOD, LOD keeping 40 percent to give 600,000 triangles per eye per frame, and a rate of 54,000,000 triangles per second at 90 frames per second.
